static_traits.name: Qiao Silin
static_traits.family_status: Strong family support, helping each other
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗；not yet有类似问题史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能自我Reflection，配合度高，态度积极；在谈及上司与反馈时表现出Significant anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: 我对与上司的关系感到矛盾：我厌恶他，但又担心他对我的工作伦理的看法。这些感受始于一年前我承担更多职责后；在我犯错时加剧，我几乎每天在Interacting with supervisor或收到绩效反馈后感到Anxiety，压力持续影响我的工作表现。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些矛盾的感受已影响我的心理健康和工作表现，我感到overwhelmed，因此寻求咨询，希望缓解Anxiety、改善工作表现并更客观地看待上司对我的看法。

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于上司的评价

special_situations.event: A supervisor points out his work mistakes in a harsh tone in project feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果被批评或语气严厉，就说明我是not称职的、not是勤奋工作者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to control emotions harder and being doubly careful to avoid repeating mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他觉得我not称职/not是勤奋的人

special_situations.event: 当我在工作中出现失误
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯错，老板会认为我not够努力，我就是not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度Self-monitoring、加班加点以证明自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我让他失望了，他会觉得我not行

special_situations.event: The boss repeatedly points out mistakes and rarely praises my work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not被表扬，说明我的努力have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断反刍负面反馈，忽视正面信息

special_situations.event: Interacting with supervisor或收到绩效反馈后
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only with my supervisor's approval am I a valuable employee
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks recognition by taking on more tasks and increasing output
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果他not认可我，我就失败了

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen by the supervisor, viewed as diligent and competent
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate、被视为not称职，从而影响工作稳定与Interpersonal relationships
defense_goal: Avoids criticism and maintains self-worth through doubling effort and self-control

object_relations.object_representation: 严厉、挑错且少表扬的上司

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked by the counselor for evidence and jointly designing a behavioral experiment to test the belief with data
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe that one needs to prove one's own value with facts and data, thereby avoiding directly touching emotional experience
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use冷静、理性、结构化的语气，强调数据与事实，尽量减少对主观感受的描述。

exception_events.target_problem: 在Interacting with supervisor或收到批评时，来访者通常会认为上司not认可自己并产生Significant anxiety，随后Decline in work concentration、错误增多。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在一次特do not忙的夜晚或完成复杂任务后，上司对她的成果给予了认可；她注意到并非所有时候上司都只看见错误，自己的努力在特定情境下被看到。
exception_events.reason: not同情境与证据：任务挑战度高、成果显著，形成可观察的正向结果；因此出现上司正向反馈，打破了以往“只被negate”的主导叙事。

positive_force: Strong family support; willing to confide and gain emotional support
Willing to participate in and carry out behavioral experiments; ample motivation to change
Able to notice evidence that contradicts the negative belief (having been recognized)
negative_force: Prone to mind reading; speculates about the boss's negative views
Mental filtering, over-focusing on negative feedback
Overgeneralization, extending one mistake to overall ability
Excessive reliance on external recognition to determine self-worth

target_behavior.behavior: Interacting with supervisor或收到负面反馈后出现Significant anxiety与Decreased attention
antecedent: 收到批评或严厉语气的反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被视为not称职/not勤奋，认知歪曲（读心术、过度概括、心理过滤）放大威胁感
target_behavior.function: 逃避负性评价与潜在惩罚，试图通过高度警觉与Self-monitoring来减少错误
target_behavior.consequence: 工作表现受损、错误增多、Tense relationships with colleagues、难以维持工作与生活平衡

target_behavior.behavior: Focusing only on negative feedback and ignoring positive information (mental filtering)
target_behavior.core_reason: 核心信念“I am not competent enough”与对外部认可的依赖使其对负面证据更敏感
target_behavior.function: 维持既有自我图式与Anticipation一致，并通过自我批评促使加倍努力以求认可
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety与Self-denial，工作投入度与Decreased efficiency
